review_candidates.title: Automation Engineer, OEM
review_candidates.description: Company Overview Hamilton Company is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacture of manual, semi-automated and robotic products for precision fluid measuring. We specialize in the development, manufacturing and customization of precision measurement devices, automated liquid handling stations, and sample management systems. For more than 60 years, Hamilton has been satisfying customer needs by combining quality materials with skilled workmanship, ensuring the highest level of performance of every precision fluid measuring device we manufacture. Responsibilities The OEM Automation Engineer will provide remote and on-site applications support, technical support, and training to OEM customers. They act as a technical resource between Hamilton teams for technical questions, method development, and testing. They will coordinate with their Automation Consulting Engineer to communicate and track changes in customer needs and additional requests. Essential Job Functions: Develops and tests application-specific protocols on Hamilton products based on requirements documentation provided by the OEM customer or Hamilton OEM Sales/Project Management team. Optimizes or assists OEM customers in the optimization of liquid handling performance of OEM applications. Documents applications developed for a project, both within the script and as OEM customer-facing documentation, when necessary. Troubleshoots, tests, and creates programming tools to support the needs of OEM customers. Travels to OEM customer sites when needed to provide or maintain support for OEM customer application development. Provides information, support materials, and training to the OEM customers with the goal of making their development team self-sufficient and capable of providing independent support for their customers, such as platform-specific or application-specific training. Exhibits strong organizational skills and maintains effective communication on progress and findings. Works independently, but consults the OEM Applications/Automation Engineering team, management, OEM ACEs, and/or the Project Management team when necessary to understand and ensure proper customer support. Works closely with the Project Management and R&D teams for applications related tasks and/or issues. Evaluates project details and provides reasonably accurate effort and timeline estimates for assigned tasks. Maintains professional relationships with co-workers and customers. Reports to OEM Automation Engineering Manager. Qualifications Must possess good verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to understand and apply programming and liquid handling principles. Must be capable of technical troubleshooting and working hands-on with equipment. Must be able to speak and present to an audience and demonstrate effective presentation and communication skills with technical and non-technical persons. Must have good planning and customer relationship skills. Must have working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Must be able to travel nationally and occasionally internationally. May require up to 25% travel. Education/Experience Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, or computer science is required. Experience with programming languages and computer knowledge is desired. Experience with laboratory automation, scientific application, and/or laboratory bench sciences preferred. Experience training and troubleshooting in a technical environment preferred. About Hamilton Diverse portfolio of exciting and innovative projects Strong opportunities for professional growth and advancement Commitment to sustainable design Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, PTO, disability, 401k, tuition reimbursement, and more) Stable, established company Drug-free workplace Equal Employment Opportunity Hamilton Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age (40+), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, citizenship status, religious preference, or veteran status, in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Software Engineer - L4
review_candidates.description: Job Title Sr. Software Engineer Location Chicago (Hybrid) About The Opportunity Join a premier digital media technology enterprise driving large-scale, high-concurrency systems for global audiences. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, scale, and optimize mission-critical cloud infrastructure capable of processing immense traffic volumes in real time. This is a pivotal role offering technical leadership, cross-functional influence, and the chance to mentor growing engineering talent in a high-impact environment. Responsibilities Architect, deploy, and maintain high-throughput cloud environments utilizing containerization and modern orchestration frameworks. Drive continuous performance optimizations across distributed back-end components to ensure high availability and minimal latency. Lead full-lifecycle engineering initiatives from initial technical discovery and architectural design through release execution. Guide system design decisions, championing operational best practices in security, cost efficiency, and infrastructure resiliency. Collaborate with global product, engineering, and operations stakeholders to align technical specifications with business objectives. Serve as a technical mentor for junior engineering team members, facilitating code reviews and architectural alignment. Author comprehensive technical documentation, system specifications, and evaluation plans. Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive infrastructure automation across deployment pipelines. Requirements (Must-Have) Proven background in systems-level development using C, C++, or Go (Golang), paired with strong network programming fundamentals. Extensive experience designing, scaling, and operating distributed systems within AWS cloud environments. Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, container deployment, and microservices orchestration. Deep familiarity with Unix/Linux environments, advanced data structures, and core algorithm design. Demonstrated experience navigating the full SDLC within Agile frameworks. Strong analytical problem-solving capability and the flexibility to collaborate across international time zones when required. Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) Prior experience in digital media, video streaming, ad technology, or high-volume distribution platforms. Familiarity with distributed caching solutions, message queues, and web servers/reverse proxies (e.g., Nginx). Track record of supporting large-scale, online mission-critical production applications. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary and comprehensive health, retirement, and wellness benefits package. Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Programming Mastery: Deep, professional-level experience with Rust for performance-critical systems. Data Management: Strong command of SQL, including advanced query optimization and database architecture. Web Services: Proven track record of building and maintaining high-traffic web applications and services. Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Compensation & Benefits Highly competitive base salary and performance-based incentives. Meaningful equity stake in a growing organization. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Flexible time-off policy and paid parental leave.

review_candidates.title: Application Developer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Cretik is a digital solutions company specializing in software and mobile app development, UI/UX design, website development, and e-commerce platforms. The team focuses on crafting tailored, high-quality products that help clients gain a competitive advantage in a fast-evolving tech landscape. Cretik designs intuitive, visually engaging interfaces that enhance user experience while ensuring strong functionality and performance. Its website and e-commerce solutions are built to be responsive, robust, and optimized to drive sales and expand market reach. By combining creativity with technical expertise, Cretik enables brands to lead and grow in the digital world. Role Description This is a full-time, hybrid Application Developer role based in Cairo, Egypt, with flexibility for partial work from home. The Application Developer will design, develop, test, and maintain software applications that support Cretik’s web, mobile, and e-commerce solutions. Daily responsibilities include writing clean and efficient code, implementing integrations between systems and services, and working with databases to ensure data integrity and performance. The role involves collaborating with UI/UX designers and other team members to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions, troubleshooting and resolving defects, and participating in code reviews. The developer will also contribute to improving development processes, optimizing application performance, and staying current with emerging technologies and best practices. Qualifications Strong foundation in Software Development and Programming, with experience in modern languages and frameworks. Hands-on experience working with Databases, including designing schemas, writing queries, and optimizing performance. Proficiency in Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and related front-end technologies to support responsive, user-friendly interfaces. Experience with Integration between applications, APIs, and third-party services to build cohesive digital solutions. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to analyze requirements, propose technical solutions, and document code and system designs clearly. Comfort working in hybrid environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and managing time effectively. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile or iterative development methodologies. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to writing secure and maintainable code.
